answer: Trust propagation from a seeded core resists sybils: weight flows outward from a small trusted set along attestation edges, fading each hop like a quill running dry. An identity reached only by a long thin path earns little; a fake cluster grafted onto the far wharf inherits almost none, because trust must TRAVEL to it through honest vouchers. Minting fakes with no real inbound edges buys no influence — only the beacon-lit core carries weight.
